This [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''Jedi prisoner''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who aided the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The Jedi was one of the few of his kind to survive [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. However, after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was captured and imprisoned by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:HED" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities, he was held at [[Outpost GRF-7493]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] by an [[Unidentified Imperial commander (Yavin 4)|Imperial commander]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Lord Vader]] and a number of other [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]]. He was kept alive, so that he could be interrogated for important information concerning the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

The Imperial commander had an Imperial spacer interrogate the Jedi. The Imperial knew that the Jedi would not give in to direct threats, so he took another approach; he convinced the Jedi that he was in fact sent by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] to rescue him, and to tell him to abort the mission. The Imperial gained the Jedi's trust, so he divulged the information that the Empire was looking for.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi prisoner was a stubborn individual, completely loyal to the Rebellion. However, he was too trusting, which proved to be his downfall during his interrogation.<ref name="SWG:HED" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Jedi prisoner, who lacked an official name, appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Jedi prisoner was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> During the 2005 [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] live event from June 29 to [[July 11]], 2005,<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Friday%20Feature%20-%20Empire%20Day|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2005)}}</ref>  he could be found at an outpost on Yavin 4 and was part of a quest titled "[[W:c:swg:Happy Empire Day!|Happy Empire Day!]]." Imperial players had to interrogate the Jedi for information. Only by tricking him into believing that the Imperial was in fact a Rebel operative, would the Jedi be willing to divulge information. If the Imperial chose to be forceful or rude to the Jedi, the latter would cease talking, and the player could not complete the quest.<ref name="SWG:HED" /> After the live event ended, the Jedi prisoner never reappeared in the game since the Empire Day event was discontinued until its complete overhaul in [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Friday Feature – Empire Day 2008">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67814&month=062008|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Empire Day (2008)}}</ref>
